title: Shut down Readyset?
warnings: myflames cannot start Readyset again once the process exits.
undo: Start the Readyset service externally through your supervisor, container runtime or orchestrator.
checks: Refresh the Readyset place to inspect the current caches, tables and status.
The Audit log keeps this attempt as Outcome unknown; nothing is sent again.

policy.title: Risky write
policy.text: Connection Readyset Admin is a Development connection. myflames asks only before risky writes, and this statement is one.
